method: Visible-only native two-contact Chromium touch; screenshots pause and clear contacts; software-WebGL. Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.

coverage: planning map opened and visibly closed
Custodian: coil I disabled; II/III not disabled at last observed HUD
failures: Sustained fire on route consumed rifle ammunition.
Trouble finding a clear coil angle near large pillar and armor.
Stationary firing under pressure ended in death.

attempts.fresh_entry: Visible START FRESH on attempt 1 terminal screen; no checkpoint retry
coverage: fresh opening guard tap aim and brief FIRE hold
no second memory, Custodian or upload reached
attempts.what_tried: Brief opening burst, then conserve ammunition while holding ROUTE. At 00:14 recovery bar was still filling; continued holding for two 12000ms waits without defensive fire.
failures: Did not defend against visible CHARGE +1 RIGHT warning.
Did not release ROUTE after SAVED as handbook directs; held through a long batch. This was reviewer execution failure, not evidence of a route bug.
Intended earlier dash/reposition strategy was not executed before death.
uncertainties: No intermediate capture during final 24-second batch; exact attack sequence and time recovery finished were not observed.
End screen showed only Mara, so later memory coverage is not inferred.

between_attempt_learning: Hold ROUTE recovers memories without a separate interaction. Save ammo while traveling; tap visible targets and move/dash under pressure. Route approach does not guarantee clear aim at a coil.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with notable friction; 10 exceptional across observed scope. Scores reflect observed interaction and presentation, not win/loss or unseen content.

controls.reason: Route and tap aim are helpful touch adaptations; manual scene turn/strafe and simultaneous defense required substantial correction in this sample.

gameplay.reason: Recovery-to-coil progression and exposure windows create understandable objectives and pressure; clear-angle hunting and stationary damage were frustrating. No upload or successful ending assessment.

presentation.reason: Coherent teal/amber industrial art, rain, weapon models and polished title/result composition; scene occlusion was prominent around the boss.

usability.reason: Useful handbook, paused map, route assist and explicit fresh/retry choice; high attention demand between recovery release, defense, aiming and tool use in portrait.

readability.reason: Health/ammo/objective and relative threat callouts are clear; secondary labels, coil percentages and result telemetry are small/dense.

scores.confidence: Limited: exactly two synthetic paused attempts. No claim about sustained enjoyment or physical-device quality.

cleanup.verification: ps -p 79062,79072 -o pid=,ppid=,command= returned no rows, exit 1; both exact owned PIDs absent. No kill performed.

helpful_moments: Handbook gives explicit two-thumb route, aim, coil-window and recovery instructions.
Route travel and hold-to-recover made all three receivers reachable in attempt 1.
Threat TURN tap changed facing and HUD names relative danger.
Tap on visible coil I centered aim and sustained fire disabled it.
Map paused with clear completed receiver checks and facility layout; visibly closed using CLOSE MAP.
Terminal screens clearly separated checkpoint retry from START FRESH and showed useful stats.
frustrating_moments: At the Custodian approach a large pillar and armor plates obscured useful aim; several manual turns and moves were needed to see coil I.
A two-second joystick strafe moved farther than I intended, requiring another turn to reacquire the coils.
Concentrating on a coil left incoming threats unresolved; health fell from 100 to 83 then 70 before the final stationary firing batch.
Dense bottom controls, route cue, warning and weapon information occupy much of a narrow portrait screen.
Small terminal telemetry and top coil labels need deliberate reading at 390px.
